results.title: Choose your church and site in Settings
results.checks: Settings → My church lists FaithNet's .church churches. Calvary Bible Church shows a Site dropdown (Boulder, Erie, Thornton, All sites); choosing Erie saves it and shows its address and service times; after a reload the dropdown still shows Erie; Care says requests go to Calvary's leaders. Saved as All sites the dropdown stays. Fort Morgan (no sites) saves without a site question.
results.note: Calvary showed its sites; Erie was saved and held after a reload; All sites kept the dropdown; Care sends to Calvary's leaders; Fort Morgan saved without a site question

results.title: Open your faith journey from the top menu
results.checks: The sidebar's ⋮ More menu lists Journey under Friends (after Groups and Church); choosing it opens the Faith page on its Journey tab. The toolbar's Prayer button still opens on Prayer.
results.note: More → Journey (under Friends) opened the Journey tab; the Prayer button opened on Prayer

results.title: Keep your groups: join one your church lists, add one of your own
results.checks: The sidebar's ⋮ More menu lists Groups and Church right under Friends. Groups shows the groups Calvary Bible Church lists. I'm in this group puts one under My groups, marked In my groups; after a reload it is still there; Leave takes it away. A group of your own is added by name and kind, shows as Your own group, and Remove takes it away.
results.note: joined AI Faith Innovation at Calvary, still there after a reload, then left it; added and removed a group of my own

results.title: Keep more than one church
results.checks: More → Church shows My church (Calvary Bible Church, Erie) and Other churches I go to. Add another church adds Fort Morgan household church without changing the main church; Remove takes it away again.
results.note: Fort Morgan was added under Other churches with Calvary still the main church, then removed
